items.name: sumo
items.description: Eclipse SUMO is an open source, highly portable, microscopic and continuous traffic simulation package designed to handle large networks. It allows for intermodal simulation including pedestrians and comes with a large set of tools for scenario creation.

items.name: flow
items.description: Computational framework for reinforcement learning in traffic control

items.name: sumo-rl
items.description: Reinforcement Learning environments for Traffic Signal Control with SUMO. Compatible with Gymnasium, PettingZoo, and popular RL libraries.

items.name: Deep-QLearning-Agent-for-Traffic-Signal-Control
items.description: A framework where a deep Q-Learning Reinforcement Learning agent tries to choose the correct traffic light phase at an intersection to maximize traffic efficiency.

items.name: sumolights
items.description: SUMO adaptive traffic signal control - DQN, DDPG, Webster's, Max-pressure, Self-Organizing Traffic Lights

items.name: Smart-Traffic-Signals-in-India-using-Deep-Reinforcement-Learning-and-Advanced-Computer-Vision
items.description: We have used Deep Reinforcement Learning and Advanced Computer Vision techniques to for the creation of Smart Traffic Signals for Indian Roads. We have created the scripts for using SUMO as our environment for deploying all our RL models.

items.name: SUMO-Traffic-Simulator-Tutorial
items.description: SUMO tutorials from SUMO Quick Start and NetEdit to TraCI, CAVs, energy & emission, and SUMO2Unity.

items.name: Multi-Agent-Distributed-PPO-Traffc-light-control
items.description: multi agent RL for traffic light control in Sumo using distributed PPO

items.name: Real-time-Traffic-Simulation-with-3D-Visualisation
items.description: Integrating SUMO with Unity to create a 3D Driving Simulator

items.name: SUMO-Unity3D-connection
items.description: This example demonstrates real-time communication between the microscopic traffic simulator SUMO and the 3D game engine Unity 3D with Python 3.7 based TCP/IP server. Video about the example: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4RiJyDnm41Q
